The '''Red & Black League''' was a criminal organization ran by [[Con artist/Legends|con artist]] [[Janstren Brell]] from his headquarters on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Herstell V]]. The organization was responsible for such notable exploits as the "[[Trancret Stock Exchange Swindle]]," the "[[Perkell Sector Mining Fleecing]]," and the "[[Ursellin Sun Jammer Race Fixings]]."
